name: Murray AI — P4.1 Gmail Reply Detector

parameters.content:
# Phase 4.1 — Gmail Reply Detector

Gmail Trigger polls every `GMAIL_REPLY_POLL_MINUTES` (default 15). For each new inbound message:

1. Look up the message's `threadId` against the Leads Board `Thread ID` column.
2. If a match is found and the lead's status != `Qualified`:
   - Call P1.3 Mark as Qualified (status -> Qualified, group -> Qualified Pipe Reply, write reply snippet + date).
   - Set Follow Up 1 + 2 Sent = true to halt all follow-up sequences for that lead.
   - Generate a draft reply via Claude.
   - Post a structured approval card to **`SLACK_APPROVAL_CHANNEL_ID` only** (dedicated outreach-approvals private channel).
   - **Persist the Slack message `ts` and the Claude draft to the Leads Board** (columns `Approval Slack TS` and `Pending Draft`). This is the single source of truth for Phase 4.2 routing — no Slack message metadata required.

## Why no Slack metadata
Slack's `metadata` field on messages is gated to Pro+ workspaces and silently stripped on Free tier. By writing `ts` + `draft` to Monday instead, Phase 4.2 can look up the routing context regardless of Slack tier and works under any Slack app config.

## Required env
```
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
ANTHROPIC_MODEL=claude-sonnet-4-20250514
SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=xoxb-...
SLACK_APPROVAL_CHANNEL_ID=C0ASZ6R2K6E
SLACK_APPROVER_USER_ID=U0ARUAQ3NPN
GMAIL_REPLY_POLL_MINUTES=15
PHASE_1_MARK_AS_QUALIFIED_WORKFLOW_ID=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_APPROVAL_SLACK_TS=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_PENDING_DRAFT=...
```

## Required credentials
- `Gmail OAuth2` (kevon@trymurmurai.app)
- `Monday.com API`

## Slack bot scopes required
- `chat:write` (post messages)

No `groups:history` or metadata scopes needed anymore.

## Idempotency
Gmail Trigger emits each new message exactly once. Combined with the `lead.status != 'Qualified'` filter, a re-emitted message will still be a no-op.
